First Stage CBT (mathematics, reasoning, general awareness, general science)

title: Executive Trainee (ET-2026) through GATE
company: Nuclear Power Corporation of India Limited (NPCIL)
salary_text: Stipend Rs 35,000 per month plus Rs 10,000 book allowance during training; Scientific Officer-C Rs 56,100 after training

requirements.text: Full-time 4-year B.E./B.Tech./B.Sc. (Engineering) or 5-year Integrated M.Tech. with at least 60% marks in aggregate
Disciplines: Mechanical, Chemical, Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, Civil
Valid GATE score of 2024, 2025 or 2026 in the relevant discipline
Shortlisting based on GATE score in Electrical / Electronics / Instrumentation
Shortlisting based on GATE score in Mechanical
Personal interview with qualifying marks of 70% (General) / 60% (reserved)
Age limit 26 years for General category (relaxations for OBC/SC/ST/PwBD)
Online registration 10 April 2026 (10:00 AM) to 30 April 2026 (4:00 PM)

title: Engineering Executive Trainee (EET) 2026 through GATE
salary_text: E1 grade, Rs 40,000 to 1,40,000 plus DA and HRA

requirements.text: Graduate degree in Electrical, Mechanical, Civil, Electronics, Instrumentation or Computer Science/IT engineering
Valid GATE 2025 registration number and score in the corresponding discipline
Civil engineering candidates shortlisted on GATE Civil score
Mechanical / Electronics candidates shortlisted on GATE score
Shortlisting based on valid GATE 2025 scores followed by further selection rounds
Application window 11 to 25 February 2026 (next cycle expected on the same annual pattern)

title: Engineer Trainee (Electrical, Electronics, Civil, Computer Science) through GATE 2026
company: Power Grid Corporation of India Limited (POWERGRID)

requirements.text: Full-time B.E./B.Tech./B.Sc. (Engg.) in Electrical, Electronics, Civil or Computer Science with minimum 60% marks or equivalent CGPA
Valid GATE 2026 score in the corresponding discipline (Electrical)
Valid GATE 2026 score in Civil Engineering
Valid GATE 2026 score in Electronics
Merit = GATE score 85% + Group Discussion 3% + Personal Interview 12%
Age limit 28 years (General/EWS), 31 (OBC-NCL), 33 (SC/ST) as on 31 December 2025

title: Graduate Engineers / Officers (Grade A) through CBT 2026

Minimum 65% marks for General/EWS/OBC(NCL); 55% for SC/ST/PwBD
Computer Based Test (CBT) on 24 September 2026 in the discipline
Group Discussion, Group Task and Personal Interview after CBT

Final degree/marksheet to be produced by 30 September 2026; applications 14 August to 3 September 2026 via ibpsreg.ibps.in/iocljun26
